lastReleaseMessage: The Asset Master List becomes the visual status board, under the no-done rule. Kane's ruling applied to all 198 rows: nothing is 100 percent done - 33 rows move to in-progress for current delivered art including the Shambler animation rows backed by the rig and baked sheet, 13 to placeholder for borrowed or outdated art and the vector stand-in widgets, and every done chip in the tab is eliminated. 39 rows carry inline art thumbnails, the Shambler clips showing frames cropped from the actual baked sheet. The Progress tab's fourteen art rows are re-aligned from done to in-progress under the same rule. Verified against cleared localStorage: thumbnails load, chips read progress, placeholder and todo, no asset claims done.

items: M1 gameplay vertical slice not yet assembled: Hold the Wall 5-7 wave mission script (bk-mission-hold, P1), Lantern Oil drain + mission-fail clock UI, Shambler + Lunger combat tuning, and Hatchery destruction + Coral Receding VFX are all still pending per the GDD Roadmap tab (docs/GDD.html)
Wood Wall / Gate / Tower cell-occupant refactor (v0.14.0) and build-menu category-tab polish still pending

MVP art + audio integration ongoing and paced by Navy's delivery cadence: HUD rebuild, Spine2D rigs, and the terrain TileMapLayer migration landed through the v0.59.x series, but remaining unit/building art and MVP-scope audio are still outstanding

Basis for the 50% hold: the art-integration track has been the active work for weeks while the six gameplay slice deliverables above are unstarted; number is evidence-anchored here, not moved, and will only advance when a real gameplay deliverable lands

barRaise.topFinding: Carry-forward pass, day 4 since the 2026-07-30 full review. One commit landed in that window, f0a00b6 on 2026-07-31, and it touched only scripts/git-guard.ps1 and scripts/push-to-github.ps1 to harden the push against the PowerShell 5.1 git stderr wrap, so no game code, GDD or asset changed and the previous run's 16 lens scores still describe the project. Health holds at 75 and the verdict holds at needs-attention. All 67 open findings aged by one run and 19 of them are now chronic. The enqueue reconciliation came back clean: every one of the 67 resolves to a live item in the work queue, none dropped. Three things did surface from the cheap signals, none of them game defects: that one commit is stamped v0.16.7 in a project whose GDD pill and project.godot both read v0.59.53, this project's queue slice is 106 items with 100 pending, 6 deferred and zero done, and the barRaise block itself carries two data defects described in the notes.

actions.title: Replace the GOD_FILES literal with a size threshold over every source/**/*.gd and regenerate scripts/.bp_baseline.json so building.gd, wave_director.gd, settings.gd and enemy_pool.gd are ratcheted.

Give enemy_pool a death or release signal that wave_director subscribes to, decrement _alive_count from it, and add a headless test asserting a pool spawn-then-release round-trips the counter to zero.
Call research._apply_effect for every restored id in save_load._apply, or add a research.restore_completed() that replays effects, and snapshot _active plus _progress.

Add keepers._owned, _pick_index, _reroll_cost, _current_offer, economy._waves_repelled and economy._first_tent_relief_fired to _snapshot() and restore them in _apply before any dependent state is rebuilt.
Rebalance the eight enemy_stats .tres move_speed values against the Numbers-tab design column so the archetype order holds and the Lunger can catch a Scout, then collapse the two columns back to one.

Take the queued tombstone option and reduce docs/ARCHITECTURE.md to a stub pointing at the GDD Architecture tab, or if it survives, delete every hardcoded line number and re-derive the class_name list, the Scout row, the HP-bar sentence and the enemy-stat source in one pass.

Add a BR-side parser modelled on YesAndChains tools/audit_dashboard.py that reads the newest CANONICAL_AUDIT severity gradings into audit.findings, and change write-dashboard-status.ps1:169 to prefer the parsed counts over the carried-forward value.
Add a routine that reads the session records' errorCategory and scheduled-tasks.json recordedSkips each morning and writes a per-task fired, failed or skipped line into the dashboard.

Fix the mechanism at the audit end by making project-canonical-audit emit both halves of every mirrored doc pair as explicit targets, or land the queued tombstone so ARCHITECTURE.md stops being a second home for facts the GDD tab already owns.
Connect save_failed and load_failed to the HUD toast path and branch the save-picker handlers on the returned bool, matching the F6/F7 feedback already in gameplay.gd:786-798.

Either treat the BR GDD as public and drop the gate pretense from CLAUDE.md and publish-gdd.ps1, or move the payload behind real server-side auth and rotate the shared editor phrase off its plaintext constant.
Copy the current X:\YesAndEverything\scripts\git-guard.ps1 over BR's copy and route the git calls in push-to-github.ps1 and publish-gdd.ps1 through Invoke-Git.
Port the $callerExitCode save-and-restore into BR's Confirm-GitIntact on every exit path, or replace both project copies with one shared helper so the next fix transfers.

Rewrite .project-context.json completion.remaining to the two genuinely open M1 items, re-anchor the percentage against the GDD Roadmap tab as of today, and fix the status writer so backlog.count reflects the open BACKLOG.md rows.
Set the declared milestone to M6 for as long as art integration is the active track and stop gating the completion percentage on a milestone that is not receiving work.

Add a preship gate that fails when a tracked .tscn references a Spine class while the gdextension or its DLLs are untracked or absent, and record the release version, URL and SHA-256 of each DLL in docs/SPINE_INTEGRATION.md.
Exempt items with attempts 0 from the stale-no-action-14d sweep, or route them to blocked-on-user instead of the archive, so a never-attempted finding is escalated rather than silently deleted.
Make the Godot-not-found branches at preship.ps1:227 and :356 call Fail rather than Skip, gated behind an explicit opt-out env var for a genuinely Godot-less machine.

Either restate the M1 card as Hatchery world placement, spawn loop, destruction and VFX and drop the duplicate M2 row, or cut enemy structures from M1 and delete the three unreferenced scaffold scripts.

Pick the pool path as canonical, route mission_setup.spawn_idle_enemies through the wave_director dispatcher, and either port dormancy and noise-wake onto enemy_pool or record in the GDD that the mechanic is scoped to per-Node spawns only.
Give enemy_pool._set_path_to_node a real path from iso_grid.find_path plus the enemy_base wall-edge redirect, budgeted per tick so a 220-enemy horde still holds frame rate.

Move the .last_released_version.txt write from release.ps1:312 to immediately after the successful push at :236, and add an end-of-run reconciliation that fails loud when the tail steps did not execute.
Strip the two ambient_light instances from the wall and gate scenes, or add a placement-time cull that lights at most every Nth wall segment.
Wire the already-delivered Beacon512 and Hatchery512 to beacon.gd and hatchery.gd now, and queue gate and tower art with Navy so the house fallback stops standing in for four distinct structures.
Strip full-line comments before counting in check_best_practices.py:39-47, re-run with --update-baseline, and confirm path_extends drops to 0.

Write a ten-line docs/LICENSES.md recording only the two genuinely missing facts - Spine editor license tier and holder, and the Spine Runtimes redistribution terms for the DLLs - cross-linking docs/SPINE_INTEGRATION.md:108-122 rather than duplicating it.
Rescope the .project-context.json:90 check string to source/ so the contamination gate becomes executable and enforceable.

Add a headless round-trip test seeding economy, research and keepers, saving, resetting, loading and asserting every field survives, plus negative cases feeding truncated JSON and a non-dict root to load_from.
Reject or clamp out-of-bounds entries in _recreate_building and _recreate_unit before instantiate, add a bounds guard inside set_tile_occupied, and cover the mismatch with a fixture save.
Bump SAVE_FORMAT_VERSION on each schema change and add a _migrate(payload, from_version) step in load_from that fills or rejects sections a given version cannot supply.
Add a godot_version / spine_godot_version / spine_editor_version block to .project-context.json and make find-godot.ps1 assert the resolved exe's --version against it, failing loudly on mismatch.

Extend scripts/check_gdd_integrity.py to fail when a deliverable id carries conflicting status across the Roadmap, Backlog and Progress tabs, then reconcile the M1 rows against the shipped four-horde m1_default.tres.
Rewrite the docs/ROADMAP.md M1 paragraph to the post-v0.13.0 reality and drop bk-audio-mvp to match the BACKLOG.md non-gating decision.

Rewrite sections 1, 3 and 10 and the :368 remainder paragraph to past tense with an explicit 'as audited 2026-06-16' framing, drop the hardcoded line counts and test figures from prose, and delete the two dead anchors.

Add docs/GODOT_BEST_PRACTICES_ADHERENCE.md to the drift-auto-fix editable set and make any count-correcting fix reject itself when the corrected number disagrees with a list enumerated in the same paragraph.
Delete the superseded 'the constant is the one knob' sentences at enemy_data.gd:50-55 and strike the two landed items from the CLAUDE.md:5 heaviest-remediation list.

Invoke write-dashboard-status.ps1 as a step of audit-rising-nightly immediately after the report is written and before retention deletes its predecessor, leaving the release path to own only version, commit and tree.
Make the milestone match tolerant of composite cells like 'M0 -> M1' and emit a matched-of-total denominator so a zero from a non-matching filter reads differently from a genuinely empty backlog.

Add the tmp-write plus os.replace plus readback plus git diff --stat verification rule to audit-rising-nightly's task file so the guard survives regardless of which snapshot of drift-auto-fix is live.

Rebuild the personal-skills snapshot from personal-skills-src with a post-write byte and NUL-count assertion, then qualify the skill name in audit-rising-nightly:9 so only one installed copy can fire.

Reshape the ask into a byproduct of play: have debug_overlay append one CSV row per wave end (wave, FPS min and avg, frame ms, draw calls, alive counts) to a user:// file, then paste that file into docs/OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md after the next normal Skirmish.
Route enemy_pool.gd:646 and :719 through spatial_index.get_units_near and replace the empty-bucket fallback at :705-707 with a widening-radius search or a cached lantern reference.
Extend check_voice.py:21 AI_NAMES with Cowork, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Devin, Aider, Anthropic and OpenAI, then rewrite the four existing occurrences to a neutral phrase.
Add docs/GDD.html to check_voice.py TARGETS and delete the mirror claim in the header comment.
Rewrite the design.html Roadmap block to M1 Vertical Slice in progress, correct 32x16 to 106x53, and add a live:milestone marker so the stamper keeps it current.

Rewrite .discord_audit_synced.txt as one newline-delimited filename per line from the current docs/ contents and change post-audit-digests.ps1:84 and :227 to write via [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines.
Add a payload freshness check that base64-decodes the ENCODED line and compares its bytes to docs/GDD.html, as a post-write round-trip assert in publish-gdd.ps1 and an advisory preship gate.
Invoke X:\YesAndEverything\scripts\update-project-pages.mjs from publish-gdd.ps1 before the YaE commit so the detail pages are stamped in the same commit as the gate page.

Add a _test_unit_collision_contracts using the existing StubGrid, asserting slide_move never lands inside an occupied tile, apply_safe_push refuses an impassable destination, and push_edge_ok rejects a blocked edge.
Extend check_secret_exposure.py to scan the resolved publish targets and list them in .project-context.json secret_exposure_paths.
Replace the enumerated webhook lines with the globs scripts/.discord_* and **/.discord_* in .gitignore.

Add a Shipping section to CLAUDE.md giving the ordered recovery: verify HEAD and origin, finish the remaining release steps via Bash, then hand-advance scripts/.last_released_version.txt and the two Discord sync markers.
Pick one progress instrument as authoritative, delete the other writer to #v1-progress-header-label, and persist the Assets-tab states into the file instead of localStorage.
Introduce an explicit grid reference set at placement time and convert the wave_director HUD lookup at :516 to the same injection before the level-scene refactor lands.

Route the options write through the same temp-write, readback and rename-with-.bak sequence save_load.save_to uses, and fall back to options.new() in global.gd when the load returns null or the wrong type.
Re-derive the queue count on the same nightly cadence as the audit block rather than at release time.

Add a preship check asserting every Building and Unit subclass script has a matching .tscn at the path save_load derives, and make the restore step count skipped entries and emit load_failed when any entry could not be recreated.
Freeze further M4 and M2 system work until one recorded playtest of the M1 Hold the Wall mission exists, and either wire or strip the inert keepers hooks in economy.gd.
Clamp restored hp into [1, max_hp] in _recreate_building and _recreate_unit and treat a non-positive saved hp as a skipped entity rather than a full-health one.
Rewrite the unit.gd:33-42 header and the :83-84 comment to the live 256px native-1.0x model without touching the 58 inherited HBH version stamps.
Reconcile the data-asset-default value on each Assets-tab row against the wired art and docs/ART_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md.
Copy BR.md into the repo or the source tree, repoint .project-context.json:63 at the real location, and either wire code-audit into audit-rising-nightly or drop the field.
Correct audit-rising-nightly:9 to fourteen tabs by their live data-tab ids, TILE_W 106 / TILE_H 53 and Godot 4.6 shipped, and make the same corrections at line 3 of the hazard catalog.
Replace both em-dash entities with a spaced hyphen in the gate page and cover it from the voice gate, either as a TARGETS entry or as a check inside Test-GatePageIntegrity.
Either drop the resources row from CLAUDE.md:44 and rename the channel variable to #rising-audit, or add the .discord_resources_webhook.txt URL file and point :37 at it.
Add token-shaped content patterns (ghp_, github_pat_, sk-, 40-hex, Bearer assignments) and the four secret filenames from .gitignore:36-38 to NAME_RE.
Migrate user://options.tres to the verified-JSON shape save_load.gd uses, or at minimum pass an explicit type hint to ResourceLoader.load and validate every field after rehydrate.
